tagline: International organization representing the inland waterway transport sector in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR is an international association with no available financial data. Member engagement, measured by participation in congresses (225 participants in 2024) and specialized colloquia (80 participants at the Loss Prevention Colloquium 2024), constitutes the organization's primary performance indicator.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the IVR annual congress across member countries.
kpis.description: The 2024 annual congress brought together 225 participants from 11 different European countries in Frankfurt am Main (May 15-17, 2024). IVR President Anneke Kooiman welcomed 225 participants to the city where the association was founded in 1877.
kpis.signal: Indicative engagement: 225 participants in 2024 (Frankfurt) representing 11 different countries

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp.
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium was held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, with approximately 80 participants representing industry professionals (insurers, brokers, marine surveyors, shipowners) from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany.
kpis.signal: Inaugural colloquium edition in 2024: 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany

kpis.name: Number of Represented Member Countries
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with representation in IVR membership and governance.
kpis.description: The organization represents the interests of the European inland waterway transport sector with 11 distinct countries represented at the 2024 annual congress.
kpis.signal: Pan-European presence with 11 countries represented at the 2024 congress

kpis.name: Total Revenue

kpis.signal: Total revenue of €2.78 billion in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital technologies in the 2024 activity report. The organization focuses on regulatory matters, loss prevention, and sectoral coordination. A single mention concerns digitalization in the context of professional qualification standards and digitalization in inland waterway navigation within the CESNI committee.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced digital technologies
Activities centered on institutional representation, congresses, technical committees, and loss prevention
Limited mention of digitalization only in the context of sectoral technical standards (CESNI) and professional qualification standards
Primary focus on regulatory issues, safety, decarbonization, and sectoral sustainability
